sideEffects: explicit UI-only rewrite; never create, reserve, retry, reorder, claim, start, or wake an Enhancement job and never persist the candidate

request.managedSourceSelectors: sourceProducerJobId and sourceManagedOutputPath are mutually exclusive; the latter follows PV-ENHANCE-VIDEO-002 displayedManagedSource validation and does not require a durable producer row
request.unknownOrDuplicateFields: reject before resolving or reading the source

response.unknownOrDuplicateFields: reject the whole response and retain the prior candidate
response.sourceSha256: 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters matching WPF's pre-request hash

candidateGrammar.opening: For the target video, at 0.00 seconds into the target video, <Picture 1> (from [Shot 1]) is fully referenced.
candidateGrammar.markerRule: each section marker occurs exactly once across the whole raw candidate and the three markers occur only in the declared order
candidateGrammar.lineEndingRule: reject a raw candidate over 8000 UTF-16 code units before converting CRLF to LF; after conversion reject every remaining carriage return
candidateGrammar.emptySectionRule: each section body contains at least one non-whitespace character
candidateGrammar.controlCharacterRule: only LF and TAB control characters are allowed

guideAnchors.openingAndDuration: base-en.txt / 2. Final Prompt Structure / 2.1 Part One Is the Instruction
guideAnchors.sectionOrder: base-en.txt / 2.2 Part Two Contains the Three Core Fields
guideAnchors.fpsAndDurationRange: README.md / System Overview / input and output specifications

conformanceProfile.shot1: the first-frame anchor remains exactly [Shot 1] without a timestamp

noMusicCompatibility.rule: accept both as NoMusic without rewriting an existing candidate; changing the writer literal requires a future versioned contract

diagnostic.mutation: analysis is pure; never repair, apply, persist, enqueue, or start a worker

conformanceProfile.applyBoundary: a candidate with any Error or a stale source/input/model/style/mode stamp cannot be applied; warning-only candidates remain eligible

readerFirst.rule: enable a route writer only after every active response reader accepts this revision
readerFirst.unknownRevision: reject the response whole, retain the prior transient candidate, and leave the authoritative input unchanged
readerFirst.malformedOrError: never persist or apply a candidate and never create an Enhancement reservation
readerFirst.rollback: the route writer may be disabled without changing the durable video job schema because candidates are UI-only
